item.title: Collect bread after school
item.context_text: Your father ordered two loaves. He asks you to collect them after school.
item.objective_text: Find the collection time and give the order number.
success_conditions: Find the collection time and give the order number.

children.title: Read the information
children.instructions: Read the note and use its details to answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
BAKERY MESSAGE
Order twelve is ready at four. Collect it at the back counter. The large bag has two loaves. The café counter only takes drink orders.

questions.explanation: The message says it is ready at four.

questions.prompt: Where should you go for the order?
questions.explanation: The back counter is named for collection. The café counter serves drinks.

children.title: Send your father a text
children.prompt_text: Father: When will you go, and where?
children.instructions: Include the time and which counter.
children.model_answer: I will go at four after school. I will get the bread at the back counter.

children.title: Ask for the bag
children.prompt_text: Worker: Hello, how can I help?
children.instructions: Say what you want to collect and give the number.
children.model_answer: Hello, I would like to collect the bread for order twelve, please.
